force_from: context (Regulatory signs: "These signs give a direction that must be obeyed")
text: a driver MUST NOT pass WHEN a "do not pass" sign applies to the road

sources.quote: Do not pass on this road.

note: The sign's own caption is a plain imperative; the legal force comes from the section introduction.

text: a driver MUST keep to the right-hand lane WHEN a "keep right except to pass" sign is posted UNLESS the driver is passing on a two-lane section where a climbing or passing lane is provided

sources.quote: Keep to the right lane except when passing on two-lane sections where climbing or passing lanes are provided.

see.figure: the "keep right except to pass" sign

text: DEFINE a long commercial vehicle IS a double-trailer vehicle THAT can be up to 40 m long AND carries an LCV placard on its rear ALSO CALLED LCV

sources.quote: This placard indicates a long commercial vehicle, which is a double trailer and can be up to 40 metres in length. It is important to be able to recognize an LCV on the highway, based on rear signage, and anticipate both the extended length and limited speed when preparing to pass one on the highway.
sources.where: Signs › Other signs › Long commercial vehicle (LCV) · ¶3

sources.quote: Title: Long commercial vehicle (LCV) - Description: Long commercial vehicle (LCV)
sources.where: Signs › Other signs › Long commercial vehicle (LCV) · image

text: a driver SHOULD anticipate the extended length AND limited speed of an LCV WHEN preparing to pass it

sources.quote: This placard indicates a long commercial vehicle, which is a double trailer and can be up to 40 metres in length. It is important to be able to recognize an LCV on the highway, based on rear signage, and anticipate both the extended length and limited speed when preparing to pass one on the highway.
sources.where: Signs › Other signs › Long commercial vehicle (LCV) · ¶3

text: a driver SHOULD NOT pass a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle WHEN it carries the "do not pass" temporary condition sign

sources.quote: Do not pass the pilot vehicle or pace vehicle bearing this sign.

flags.span: Do not pass the pilot vehicle
flags.note: The section presents these signs as warnings, so no legal force; the wording is a direct prohibition.
flags.zh: 該段把這類標誌當作警告，不給法律效力；但用字是直接禁令。

see.figure: the "do not pass" pilot vehicle sign

text: a driver in [?slow traffic] MUST keep right WHEN on a multi-lane road where a "slower traffic keep right" sign is posted

sources.quote: Slow traffic on multi-lane roads must keep right.

flags.note: No speed given; slow compared with the traffic around it.
flags.zh: 沒有給速度；是跟周圍車流相比的慢。

note: The caption of a regulatory sign. It is the legal side of keeping right so faster traffic can pass (2.1d, 3.6.1a).
